summary.ru: Южная Хань — государство, существовавшее в период Пяти династий вдоль южного берега Китая с 917 до 971 года. Столицей царства был город Паньюй. Это современный город Гуанчжоу.
summary.en: Southern Han, officially Han, originally Yue, was a dynastic state of China and one of the Ten Kingdoms that existed during the Five Dynasties and Ten Kingdoms period. It was located on China's southern coast, controlling modern Guangdong and Guangxi. The dynasty greatly expanded its capital Xingwang Fu (Chinese: 興王府; pinyin: Xìngwáng Fǔ; Jyutping: Hing1 Wong4 Fu2, present-day Guangzhou). It attempted but failed to annex the autonomous polity of Jinghai, which was controlled by the Vietnamese.
